paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for vaccine-related sentiments, with the x-axis representing polarity scores ranging from -1.0 to 0.6 on a linear scale, marked at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis shows the corresponding counts, ranging from 0 to 8000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2000. A single blue line with circular markers connects data points, showing a gradual increase in counts from near zero at -1.0 to approximately 3000 at -0.2, followed by a sharp rise to a peak of about 8000 at 0.0. The counts then drop to approximately 3000 at 0.2, rise again to about 5000 at 0.2, and then decline to roughly 2000 at 0.4 before falling to near zero at 0.6. The distribution is skewed toward neutral polarity, with the highest frequency occurring at a score of 0.0.
